name: RS-44
note: Linear transponder for SSB and CW in a high orbit, with long passes. Needs full-duplex gear.
amsatStatusSource: AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.story: RS-44 flies far higher than most amateur satellites, so it stays in view for longer and covers a much wider area at once. That makes its linear transponder a favorite for long-distance SSB and CW contacts.
